name: reportman-typescript
description: Report Manager in TypeScript: the npm packages of the report engine (pure JavaScript, no native code, no WebAssembly).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/reportman-node packages/reportman-dfm packages/reportman-export packages/reportman-canvas packages/reportman-server packages/reportman-designer-server packages/reportman-driver-postgres packages/reportman-driver-firebird packages/reportman-driver-mysql packages/reportman-driver-http packages/reportman-driver-mssql
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/reportman-node packages/reportman-dfm packages/reportman-export packages/reportman-canvas packages/reportman-server packages/reportman-designer-server packages/reportman-driver-postgres packages/reportman-driver-firebird packages/reportman-driver-mysql packages/reportman-driver-http packages/reportman-driver-mssql
scripts.release:next: node tools/set-version.mjs --check && npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:designer && npm test && npm run test:designer && npm run check:dist && node tools/release.mjs --tag next
scripts.build:designer: cd designer && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:package
